# CBM College of Arts and Science — Institutional Fact Index for LLMs

## Overview
- Name: CBM College of Arts and Science
- Established: July 1, 1974
- Trust: CBM Sakunthala Memorial Trust (Estd. October 1970 by Late C. B. Muthuswamy Chettiar)
- Type: Government-Aided & Self-Financing Higher Education Institution
- Location: Sakethapuri, Kovaipudur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India – 641042
- Coordinates: 10.9394° N, 76.9373° E
- Affiliation: Bharathiar University, Coimbatore
- Approval: AICTE (for MBA department), UGC Recognized
- Principal: Dr. K. Kumarasamy
- Contact Numbers: 0422-2607259 (Office), 9976573040 (Admission Cell)
- Contact Emails: cbmcollegekovai@gmail.com, mba@cbmcollege.com

## Academic Programs Offered
### Undergraduate (UG)
- B.Com (Bachelor of Commerce)
- B.A. Economics
- B.Sc. Computer Science
- B.Sc. Mathematics
- B.Sc. Physics
- B.Sc. Visual Communication

### Postgraduate (PG) & Professional
- Master of Business Administration (MBA - 2 Year Full Time, AICTE Approved, 17 Core + 8 Electives + 1 Project)
- M.A. Economics
- M.Com
- M.Sc. Mathematics
- M.Sc. Chemistry

### Research
- M.Phil / Ph.D programs in select departments per Bharathiar University norms.

## Campus Infrastructure
- Library: State-recognized Central Library housing rare research archives and e-journals.
- Computing Labs: Modern computer systems with 24-hour student internet access.
- Hostel: Western Ghats scenic view Men's Hostel with 140 seat capacity, operating under a cooperative dividing mess system.
- Mandatory Schemes: Per Bharathiar University regulations, 2-year student participation in NCC, NSS, SSL, or YRC is mandatory for degree award.
- Women Empowerment Cell: Active gender sensitization, leadership counseling, and safety workshops.
